title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 58 (Masset)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Masset
58 That portion of M.U. 6-13 in the vicinity of Masset, described as follows: All of the area contained within District Lots 7, 7A, 8, 9, 10, 11, 233, 234, 347, 348, 361, 749, 883, 986, 987, 1759 and 1760 of the Queen Charlotte Land District. [am. B.C. Reg. 109/85, s. 3 (f).]
